# Scarlet Tech

> Scarlet Tech is a wireless IoT safety and environmental monitoring expert providing ATEX-certified devices for occupational hazard detection in oil & gas, construction, and industrial worksites.

Scarlet Tech specializes in real-time monitoring solutions including wireless anemometers, sound level meters, heat stress monitors, and crane cameras. The company serves global markets through 50+ distributor partners and maintains a commitment to worker safety through certified, connected devices.

## Key Topics

- Occupational Safety
- Environmental Monitoring
- ATEX Certification
- Wireless IoT
- Crane Safety
- Noise Measurement
- Heat Stress Monitoring
- Industrial Safety
- Data Logging
- Class 1 Sound Meters
- Intrinsically Safe Devices
- WindPro System
- Construction Safety
- IEC Standards
- OSHA Compliance

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Products](https://scarlet-tech.com/products): Scarlet product catalog: anemometers, heat meters, sound meters, crane cameras
- [Wireless Anemometers](https://scarlet-tech.com/product-category/wireless-anemometers): Wireless anemometers (WR-3 Plus, E11, WindPro) for crane and industrial wind safety
- [Sound Level Meters](https://scarlet-tech.com/product-category/sound-level-meters): Class 1 & 2 sound level meters (ST-12D, ST-15D, ST-25D, ST-130) for noise monitoring
- [Wireless Crane Cameras](https://scarlet-tech.com/product-category/wireless-crane-cameras): Wireless crane cameras (SV300, HerculesPro) for safe crane operations and blind spot elimination
- [Heat & Weather Stations](https://scarlet-tech.com/product-category/heat-and-weather-stations): Heat stress meters (TWL-1S, TWL-1SV) for WBGT and worker heat exposure monitoring
- [Explosion Proof Products](https://scarlet-tech.com/product-category/explosion-proof-products): ATEX-certified explosion-proof devices (E11, SL-27) for hazardous Zone 1 & 2 areas

## Wind Monitoring Systems

- [Wireless Wind Speed Meter WR-3 Plus](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/wireless-wind-speed-meter-wr3): WR-3 Plus wireless anemometer: cost-effective crane safety wind speed monitoring device
- [Wind Speed & Anemometer Data Logger WL-21](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/wind-data-logger): WL-21 wireless wind data logger with combined speed & direction display for monitoring
- [Ex-Proof Intrinsically Safe Anemometer E11](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/intrinsically-safe-anemometer-e11): E11 ATEX-certified intrinsically safe anemometer for Zone 1 & 2 hazardous areas
- [WindPro Wireless Wind Monitor System](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/windpro-wireless-wind-monitor-system): WindPro cloud-based wind monitoring system with 24/7 data storage and auto reporting
- [WindPro Online - Real-Time Web Portal](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/windpro-online-wind-monitor-system): WindPro Online: real-time web portal wind monitoring with instant speed alerts

## Noise & Sound Measurement

- [Class 1 Sound Level Meter ST-11D](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/class-1-sound-level-meter-st-11d): ST-11D Class 1 sound meter: IEC 61672-1 certified for occupational noise measurements
- [ST-12D Class 1 Professional Sound Level Meter](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/sound-level-meter-st-12d): ST-12D Class 1 sound meter with octave band analysis for professional noise assessment
- [Class 1 Sound Analyzer ST-15D with GPS](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/class-1-sound-analyzer-st-15d): ST-15D advanced sound analyzer with GPS location tagging for noise source detection
- [Personal Noise Dosimeter ST-591](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/personal-noise-dosimeter-st-591): ST-591 noise dosimeter: IEC 61252-1 compliant for occupational noise exposure monitoring
- [Noise Dosimeter ST-130](https://scarlet-tech.com/products/noise-dosimeter-st-130): ST-130 cost-effective noise dosimeter for OSHA and IEC noise accumulation surveys
